messages:
Liam: Heads-up — onboarding call with InsuraTech 2pm PT. They want a hardened capacity plan: strict device affinity to A100v4, 10% safety margin, and a tokens-pricing swap that caps overage costs. Need quick ops + billing notes. @Priya @Marco
Priya: Got it. Quick Q — reserved GPUs OR guaranteed throughput? RFP says reserved pool + burst credits.
Marco: From infra side I recommend RESERVED_POOL=8 A100v4 (baseline throughput ~6k tok/s), burst to 12 with spot fallback. Also prewarm KV cache for their top-10 prompts. Soft affinity example below:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 8
  max_replicas: 12
  target_rps: 5000
  device_affinity: "A100v4-preferred"
  affinity_mode: "soft"
  prewarm_prompts: 10
```
Tess: SRE note — strict AZ affinity will bump cold starts and reduce reclaim. Recommend 'soft' affinity + cross-AZ fallback with warm pool in primary AZ. Also add throttle policy for traffic spikes.
Nora: Billing: for the tokens-pricing swap proposal — offer tiered overage rebate: >1B tokens/mo -> 15% off overage price; cap monthly burst charges at $75k for the POC. Need signoff from finance/legal.
Liam: Customer legal asks for availability SLA 99.5% and a max monthly cost cap for the POC. We'll need to confirm whether cap matches reserved pricing + capped burst.
Priya: I'll draft a 1-pager runbook covering: traffic profile, prewarm windows, device_affinity, autoscale policy, and billing guardrails. Send sample RPS curve from customer and I can align numbers.
Marco: Also note quantization option (int8) can double density and reduce GPU count — tradeoffs: may affect quality. Good to include in eval criteria.
sec-bot: Security reminder — KMS integration required for Private deployment answers in questionnaire. Link: https://redwood.internal/kms-onboarding
Liam: Great. Action items: @Priya draft runbook, @Marco prod autoscale snippet + cost estimate, @Nora finance cap proposal. Meeting in 30. :thumbsup:
